analysis.multiple_comparisons: 46 pairwise tests were run. No correction is APPLIED because the tests are reported as a family and not used to select a winner; at alpha = 0.05 a Bonferroni threshold would be 0.001087 and any p above it should be read as uncorrected. 7h's ranking rule governs instead: an ordering whose confidence intervals overlap is reported as 'not separable at this sample size'.
